query.description: Search text. Accepts nonempty Unicode text of up to 2048 characters. Specific keywords work best. Restrict sites with domains rather than site: operators.

limit.description: Maximum results. Accepts 1–20, default 10. Fewer results may return, especially with domains.

language.description: Language hint. Accepts all or a SearXNG language code such as en or zh-CN. all avoids a language preference.

time_range.description: Recency hint for the provider. Accepts any, day, week, month or year, default any. It is not a strict publication-date filter.

domains.description: Restrict results to these hosts and their subdomains. Accepts up to ten DNS names without scheme or path. For example ["qgis.org"] matches qgis.org and docs.qgis.org but not notqgis.org. Empty allows all domains. Filtering happens after the search, so fewer than limit results may return.

items.description: Domain name. Accepts Unicode or ASCII DNS hostname. IDNA normalization makes equivalent hostnames match.
